recipe.name: find_used_cars
recipe.purpose: Used car listings on sauto.cz for a make and model under a maximum price in Kč.

inputs.name: make
inputs.description: Car make as the user wrote it, e.g. Tesla, BMW, Škoda

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: Model name as the user wrote it, e.g. Model 3, i4, Enyaq

inputs.name: max_price
inputs.description: Maximum price in Kč as a number
